# BYZ scope. Chance in percent that haggling in .1 b succeeds (design 3.5).
oe_itp_haggle_ch = {
    value = 30
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:VEN
            c:VEN = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { country_exists = c:GEN is_at_war_with = c:GEN }
                    AND = { country_exists = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR }
                }
            }
        }
        add = 20
    }
    if = { limit = { navy_size >= oe_itp_navy_ven_half } add = 15 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims var:oe_itp_ven_claims > 20 } add = -15 }
    min = 5
    max = 80
}

# BYZ scope. What strains the grain road: caffa +1; embargo +1; crm +1; genwar +1; galata +1; sided +1; straits +1; blockade +2 (each row is the trigger oe_itp_gr_<key>). The test page adds oe_itp_grain_fake.
oe_itp_grain_up = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_caffa = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_embargo = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_crm = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_genwar = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_galata = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_sided = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_straits = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_blockade = yes } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_grain_fake } add = var:oe_itp_grain_fake }
}

# BYZ scope. What eases it: convoy -1; own -1; pledge -1; posts -1.
oe_itp_grain_down = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_convoy = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_own = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_pledge = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_gr_posts = yes } add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. The two together, kept within 0-2.
oe_itp_grain_raw = {
    value = oe_itp_grain_up
    subtract = oe_itp_grain_down
    min = 0
    max = 2
}
